pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100, AMD FX4350 or equivalent.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB, AMD Radeon R9 290 4GB, or equivalent.
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590, AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, or better.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, AMD Radeon RX 480, or better.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
